name: Kono Darashi no Nai Da-megami ni Haiboku o! ~Bitch no Yuuwaku ni wa Zettai ni Maketakunai Kei ADV~
original_name: このダラしのない堕女神に敗北を!～ビッチの誘惑には絶対に負けたくない系ADV～
source:
While M*gumin and L*latina is out due to quests,
Aq*a spends her time only drinking and sleeping.
So K*zuma (you) warns her to work:
"Hey you... Your debauched life is over NOW!
We are running out of money. Work bitch, work!"

But her response is not what you expected...

"Well, that shouldn't be problem if you earn money instead. Please support me!"

"What!?"

"I don't mean to take it without giving... I know you are somehow 'frustrated'.
If you give me some support... I'd forgive you to help yourself before me."

With spiteful grinning toward his crotch, she laughs at his virginity...

This is the beginning of the 'battle' between the two.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE214802.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
虽然M*gumin和L*latina因任务而缺席，
Aq*a只把时间花在喝酒和睡觉上。
所以K*zuma（你）警告她要工作：
“嘿，你……你的放荡生活已经结束了！
我们的钱快用完了。干活儿，干活儿！”

但她的反应却出乎你的意料……

“嗯，赚钱的话应该没问题，请支持我！”

“什么！？”

“我并不是想不付出就索取……我知道你有些‘沮丧’。
如果你给我一些支持……我会原谅你在我面前帮助自己。”

她对着他的胯部恶狠狠地一笑，嘲笑他的童贞……

这就是两人‘战斗’的开始。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE214802.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
